question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Memory
solution:
The correct answer is "Oblivion."**
 

*__Key Points__ 

 

__
 
• The word "Memory" means a person’s ability to remember things. (स्‍मृरणशक्ति; याददाश्‍त)

 
 
• Example:* After the accident he suffered from loss of **memory**__.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of "Memory" is "Oblivion."
 
• The word "Oblivion" means a state in which you do not realize what is happening around you, usually because you are unconscious or asleep. (चेतना-शून्‍यता की स्थिति (क्‍योंकि व्‍यक्ति बेहोश, संज्ञाहीन या सोया हुआ है))
 __
 
• Example: I was in a state of complete **oblivion**__.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 2.

• Suppress: **to prevent something from being seen or expressed or from operating. (किसी चीज़ को दिखने या व्यक्त होने या संचालित होने से रोकना)
 
• **Retrospection: **the action of looking back on or reviewing past events or situations, especially those in one's own life. (अतीत की घटनाओं या स्थितियों, विशेष रूप से किसी के अपने जीवन की घटनाओं पर पीछे मुड़कर देखने या उनकी समीक्षा करने की क्रिया)
 
• **Impart: **to pass information, knowledge, etc. to other people. (अन्‍य व्‍यक्तियों को जानकारी पहुँचाना, ज्ञान प्रदान करना)
